title: CE60111: Viscous Fluid Flow
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction to inviscid and viscous fluid flow; fundamental equations of
viscous flow; continuity equation; Navier-Stokes equations; Couette flows; twoand three-dimensional boundary layers; similarity solution for two-dimensional
flow; free shear flow; approximate integral method; stability of flow; concept
of small disturbance stability; linearized stability of parallel viscous flow;
parametric effects in the linear stability theory; transition to turbulence.
